facts.text: John shared a photo of himself performing a yoga pose on a blue mat.

evidence.quote: Here's a photo of me in this pose. It's a good way to work out your legs and core. Give it a shot! [image: a photography of a man doing a yoga pose on a blue mat]

facts.text: John holds the yoga pose for a duration of 30 to 60 seconds.

facts.text: John enjoys practicing yoga poses that challenge both his body and mind.
